verbs.name: setup
verbs.summary: Install into the repository: cargo fetch and bun install --cwd cli (this CLI's own type packages) for core, and for macos bun install --frozen-lockfile in apps/macos from its committed bun.lock (refusing where it is missing) plus cargo fetch --locked for apps/macos/src-tauri. Safe to rerun.

verbs.name: build
verbs.summary: Build the product binary target/release/omadai with cargo build --release --workspace. The macOS app's build is not behind this verb yet.

verbs.name: doctor
verbs.summary: Read-only health check of the development toolchain: rustc, cargo, rustfmt, clippy and bun versions, whether omarchy-plugin-validate is on PATH and /usr/lib/qt6/bin/qmllint exists, and whether cli/node_modules and apps/macos/node_modules exist. Changes nothing and does not run the product's own omadai doctor.

verbs.name: check
verbs.summary: Static and test gate for the Rust workspace and the plugin: typecheck the CLI, then cargo fmt --check, cargo clippy --workspace --all-targets -- -D warnings, cargo test --workspace, and omarchy-plugin-validate on a temporary directory holding only manifest.json and Panel.qml (the repository root holds node_modules symlinks the validator refuses), then /usr/lib/qt6/bin/qmllint on Panel.qml, with a temporary import directory whose qs entry links to /usr/share/omarchy/shell so the qs.Commons and qs.Ui imports resolve, since the validator checks only the manifest; installs nothing and stops at the first failing step. apps/macos/src-tauri is outside the workspace and is not checked.

verbs.name: plugin-dev
verbs.summary: Install this checkout's plugin files (manifest.json, Panel.qml) as $HOME/.config/omarchy/plugins/daftmause.omadai/: copy them to a new, uniquely named staging directory in $HOME/.config/omarchy/, outside the plugins/ tree the shell watches, run omarchy-plugin-validate on it, then swap it in with one atomic rename (mv -T --exchange where the destination exists, mv -T where it does not), so the shell never sees a partial plugin (a reinstalled Panel.qml takes effect after omarchy-restart-shell), and delete the displaced tree only after the swap succeeded. On any failure it removes only the staging directory. Refuses, changing nothing, where the destination is a git checkout, holds a file other than those two, or holds a manifest.json or Panel.qml matching neither the checkout nor the digest saved at the last successful plugin-dev, so an omarchy plugin add install or a hand edit there is never lost; --dry-run prints the paths and the steps. Writes outside the repository.
